name: MARGIT
desc: The individual appears to be a middle-aged male, likely between 50 and 65 years of age, with a wiry but sturdy build suggesting a life of physical activity. He has a riotous mane of long, curly hair in a vibrant shade of red-orange. His eyes are a striking emerald green, set within a complexion of fair skin with a slightly weathered texture. Several freckles are scattered across his nose and cheeks. A prominent, slightly crooked nose and a wide mouth with a hint of a mischievous grin are notable features. He bears a small scar just above his left eyebrow. The character is wearing a dark green hooded cloak fastened with a simple bronze clasp, layered over a brown leather tunic and matching trousers. A worn leather belt cinches his waist, holding a sheathed dagger at his hip. He also wears brown leather bracers on his forearms and a small, decorative brooch pinned to his cloak.
